MIMTO-DCT-CRM-DCT-ROLIN.

2-AWY M/UM859 RUVOM-KARDE SEGMENT CLSD.

UDROS-DCT-CRM-DCT-ROLIN.

UDROS-DCT-CRM-M/UM11-TBN.

INSTEAD OF THIS ROUTE ALL ACFT COULD FOLLOW AWY G/UG901 BALUM-CRM 
BIDIRECTIONALLY.
4-AWY M/UM10 OLUPO-GOKPA SEGMENT CLSD.
INSTEAD OF THIS ROUTE ALL ACFT COULD FOLLOW OLUPO-DCT-CRM.
